item.title: Delayed Christmas tree recycling program to resume Monday
item.description: The program was delayed due to the atmospheric river storm that doused the region over the Christmas holiday.

item.title: Page-turners you might have missed as the year winds down
item.description: Whether you’re hoping to close out the year or enter the new one with something great, these gems deserve a spot on your nightstand.

item.title: Housing, yoga and ice cream engage Ocean Beach in 2025
item.description: The charm of Ocean Beach is that it's a seaside community with bohemian vibes and an independent streak. Here's what happened there in 2025.

item.title: Our 5 most popular arts stories in 2025 – a painter, perseverance and Petco
item.description: Times of San Diego is home to a bustling arts section, with weekly concert listings and frequent theater reviews. A neighborhood focus gives local artists a space to shine while still promoting hometown heroes who made it big and various visiting national creatives. Beyond artists themselves, we’ve also done standout reporting on how local orgs […]

item.title: Opinion: In uncertain times, community support is the biggest gift of all
item.description: Cuts in federal support for social services threaten programs at Father Joe's Villages, but the San Diego community can help.

item.title: California law banning ICE agents from wearing masks under fire from Trump administration, state agencies
item.description: In January, a new law will ban federal agents from covering their faces, putting local and state police at odds with masked immigration agents.

item.title: Despite bowl game uncertainty, Holiday Bowl coaches make case for tradition in new era
item.description: Rhett Lashlee, SMU's head coach, called the 2026 Holiday Bowl game "a great bowl matchup, at a great bowl venue.”

item.title: When the game’s not the thing – casket tosses, Pop-Tarts and other bowl game oddities
item.description: An "Inheritance Toss" will be featured at half-time, in which a contestant wins $10,000 if they can throw a football into a festive casket.

item.title: New California law expands CARE court
item.description: CARE Court provides a new pathway for the courts to coordinate mental health and substance use treatment, medications and housing placements.

item.title: MarketInk: Retired newsman expected a relaxing 2025 — then the SD Press Club called
item.description: The veteran television news reporter said that the organization approached him about serving on the board of directors.
